ModMetaData.name: Pawn Target Fix
ModMetaData.author: fed1sPlay
ModMetaData.description:
Improves how pawns automatically choose shooting targets.
• Toggle between accuracy-first or proximity-first targeting • Configurable weighting and near-range bias • Options for handling downed enemies (none, deprioritize, ignore) • Target “stickiness” to reduce rapid swapping • Recent-target bonus acts like a minimum retarget interval • Preserves friendly-fire awareness • Fully translatable (English, Chinese, Japanese, German, French, Russian)
Manual targeting is always respected. Compatible with most combat mods.
